text:
```yaml
name: Check Branch Alias

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

jobs:
  check-branch-alias:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.1'
          extensions: mbstring, intl
          tools: composer

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer install --no-progress --no-suggest

      - name: Check branch alias
        run: |
          if [[ $(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) == "main" ]]; then
            echo "On main branch, checking for valid branch alias..."
            if ! grep -q "dev-main" composer.json; then
              echo "Error: Branch alias 'dev-main' not found in composer.json"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "Branch alias check passed"
          else
            echo "Not on main branch, skipping branch alias check"
          fi
```
